backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping authentication-related features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining OKLCH color tokens and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint containing SEO meta tags and mounting point for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with Layout and page routes for Home, About, Services, and Contact.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Authentication control component using Internet Identity to display sign‑in/out buttons and status handling.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client-side contact form with validation, loading state, and mock submission success message.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper rendering the SiteHeader, Outlet content area, and SiteFooter.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer displaying branding, navigation links, social icons, and attribution using siteConfig values.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with desktop and mobile navigation plus integrated authentication controls.
frontend/src/content/siteConfig.ts: Defines site-wide business info, navigation, hero content, highlights, about details, and service listings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Updates the document title and meta description when page-level metadata changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder for future React Query hooks; currently contains no logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a custom color system for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app, wrapping it with query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with hero, story, and values sections using siteConfig content.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders the Contact page with hero, contact details, and a form using siteConfig data.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page component rendering hero, highlights, and CTA sections using siteConfig data and setting page meta tags.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Services page displaying a hero section, a grid of services from siteConfig, and a CTA, with meta tags set via usePageMeta.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and container settings with plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, requirements, and architectural notes for the website build.
